The mutant stops calling _record_failure when a synchronous provider call fails. Fallthrough, the failed → successful trace order and re-raising the last error all still work, so REQ_SYNC_ROUTE_FALLBACK is still met. What changes is the failure bookkeeping (route health and key cooldown) that should steer later routing away from failed routes. That is part of the Route fallback feature and the reliability goal, but no stated requirement covers it, so it can't be decided within this requirement.
